items.reason: A gentle, non-active cleanser suits dry-looking skin with low moisture.
Azelaic acid 10% is a gentle option for helping uneven-looking dark patches appear more even.
A rich ceramide cream helps support a skin barrier that scored low on moisture.
Tinted mineral SPF with iron oxides helps protect against sun and visible light that can make dark patches look deeper.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% peel and the 1% retinol because strong actives can irritate dry skin and, on deeper skin tones, may leave patches looking darker, so start gently: cleanser, azelaic acid, and moisturizer in the evening, and cleanser, moisturizer, and tinted SPF each morning. If the patches persist, darken, or change, it is best to have a dermatologist look at them rather than add more products.
